title: Elytra Component
description: This is a mod that attaches the elytra to the chestplate.
body:
This is a module that attaches the elytra to the chestplate.
You can configure which armor can be attached to items as data components in the data package.
You can find data/modname/elytra_components/xxx.json to add elytra component from other mods.
